# `factory/projects.py`

[As built](../../README.md) › [Server API and project management](../../subsystems/server-api-and-project-management.md) › `projects.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Defines the Project class and ProjectRegistry for managing repositories the factory works on, including their gates (quality checks), environment configuration, evidence ledger, and scaffolding proposals.

2,976 lines, in Server API and project management.

## Parts

Too big to be one node, so shown in 8 parts: groups of its functions that call each other more than the rest of the file.

| Part | Lines | Functions | Largest | Calls out · in |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|
| **Applying survey proposals** — Takes the diff from a repo survey and applies it to the project's proposed checks and parts, tracking which paths have been watched and read and answering pending survey requests. Centered on apply_survey_diff and record_reading, which keep the project's view of proposed changes in sync with what's been surveyed. | 402 | 9 | `apply_survey_diff` | 10 · 2 |
| **Approving project setup** — Records approval of a project's state -- saving the survey, baseline, check runs and skills directory, and computing fingerprints and digests used to detect drift. Built around approve and save, which persist the approved configuration, with record_survey_started and record_failure tracking the approval lifecycle. | 390 | 11 | `approve` | 4 · 4 |
| **Diagnosing gate and environment problems** — Inspects a project's gates, environment and working directory to surface problems before checks run, including preview-specific issues. gate_problems and environment_problems do the bulk of this, with _script_body supplying the check script text they inspect. | 328 | 5 | `gate_problems` | 0 · 2 |
| **Applying and undoing scaffolding proposals** — Manages proposed scaffolding for checks and parts -- applying it, listing what's proposed, and undoing proposed checks or parts if rejected. apply_scaffolding and proposed_scaffolding drive this, with scaffolding_state tracking where each proposal stands. | 299 | 9 | `apply_scaffolding` | 3 · 4 |
| **Managing check recommendations** — Lets the project adopt or decline recommended checks, raising them from guide checks or command problems and keying them for tracking. adopt_recommendation and raise_recommendation do the work of turning a suggestion into a live check, while decline_recommendation retires one. | 298 | 7 | `adopt_recommendation` | 3 · 0 |
| **Migrating project Dockerfiles** — Handles moving a Dockerfile between the factory's managed location and the repo itself as part of fixing a diagnosed problem, including retiring the old one and writing the new one. apply_diagnosis_fix and move_dockerfile_into_repo carry this, with dockerfile_state and repo_dockerfile tracking where it currently lives. | 258 | 9 | `apply_diagnosis_fix` | 0 · 0 |
| **Declining and reinstating gates** — Updates a project's gate state, letting checks or whole families of checks be declined, reinstated or ratcheted, and holding back new code until gates pass. update and decline_family/reinstate_family do the bulk of this, with declined_gates reporting the current state. | 251 | 9 | `update` | 2 · 10 |
| **Project registry CRUD** — Basic lifecycle operations for projects in the registry -- creating, listing, fetching, checking existence and deleting them -- plus resolving a project's slug and feature store. create, get and list are the core lookups that the rest of the registry builds on. | 141 | 9 | `delete` | 1 · 1 |
